_doc: Shared data registry (no project data). Key = first-level physical directory (or `path`). zone: system|knowledge|workspaces|external. class: log|cache|artifact|durable (default retention/caps per class, see src/data.rs). retentionDays overrides class. Only zones the Rust code actually writes are listed; add project zones in a project registry.

audit.note: date= partitions older than retentionDays are pruned by the audit writer when a new day starts
